title: YT-1300 Transport
caption: YT-1300 Transport (V)
game_text: May add 1 pilot and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. While all your ability is provided by aliens, Jedi, and {independent} starship pilots, this starship is forfeit +1, maneuver +1, and immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Reliable and durable, Widely used freighter made by Corellian Engineering Corporation. Sales have dramatically increased in proportion to the fame of Han Solo’s ship.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1999 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Sheet group: Rebel Cell. Non-unique (no dot). Slip heading prints 'YT-1300 Transport  (V)' with a double space; caption 'YT-1300 Transport (V)'. Banner STARFIGHTER: MODIFIED LIGHT FREIGHTER. Stats POWER 2 / MANEUVER 3 / HYPERSPEED 5 (as printed); deploy 2 / forfeit 4 (printed 3 / 5). Scomp-link ring → scomp true. Inline icon before 'starship pilots' is the blue spoked wheel = Independent → {independent}; the STUB READS IT AS 'Rebel' — wrong. Icon column top to bottom: independent (blue wheel), pilot helmet on yellow (permanent pilot — 'Permanent pilot provides ability of 1'), nav computer (red, astromech dome); printed card: Pilot, Nav Computer, Independent. LORE: printed 'Reliable and durable, Widely used…' — the scan shows a COMMA after 'durable' before a capital W (Decipher misprint; wiki has a period) — kept as printed, confirm on a better scan (350 px only; the VB4 remake shows the same comma). Curly apostrophe in Solo’s assumed (350 px, not certain). Copyright Endor line ('© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1999 DECIPHER INC.') roughly legible. Modern: Virtual Block 4 only (VB4-L-yt1300transport-pre.gif, 350 px; non-pre also exists).
